messages:
Leah (People Ops): Heads up folks 1 Cohort starts tomorrow (1 remote, 2 onsite). Need I-9s done for onsite between 9:30-11:00. Can someone cover the verification kiosk and escort? :raising_hand:
Noah (Facilities): I can cover 9:30-10:15. Who's covering the last slot?
Priya (IT): Ill do 10:15-11:00. Laptops will be staged at front desk by 8:45 with COHORT-APR26 asset tags.
Leah (People Ops): Parking: we have two visitor permits. Noah please submit license plates here: https://intranet.redwood/parking. Front desk needs name + plate printed on pass.
Maya (New Hire): Quick flag  my passport is mid-renewal and the name spelling is slightly different on the renewal receipt. Background vendor flagged "pending docs". Can I still do orientation in-person tomorrow?
HR-Bot: FYI: I-9 remote rules + acceptable docs: https://www.uscis.gov/i-9/list-of-acceptable-documents. Vendor NotaryNow supports remote notarization; code REDWOOD-ONBOARD.
Leah (People Ops): You can attend the orientation activities, but HR needs I-9 completed within 3 business days. If passport is mismatched, we may accept state ID + renewal receipt + signed affidavit temporarily. Escalating to Compliance.
Compliance-Team: We can accept a current state ID + receipt for passport renewal + signed candidate affidavit. Please upload scanned docs to the vendor portal and cc compliance@redwood.com. Follow-up: provide passport copy within 90 days.
Noah (Facilities): Note: front desk security requires an escort for new hires without finalized badge. Ill meet them at lobby at 9:25.
Priya (IT): Laptop config: standard image, user account created (temp email: maya.new@redwood.test). Ill include Wi-Fi sticker (onboard-guest) and buddy contact on the box.
Leah (People Ops): Benefits intro will run at 11:00 via Zoom. Maya, well add you to the Zoom link so you can join remotely if needed.
Maya (New Hire): Thanks. Ill upload state ID + renewal receipt tonight and email compliance. If anything else needed, please ping me.
Priya (IT): Also sending a calendar invite to the cohort with onboarding checklist and security training link.
Leah (People Ops): Catering: light breakfast (pastries + coffee) for onsite folks. Approving $50. Noah, can you swing by the usual cafe at 8:15?
Noah (Facilities): Yep, on it.
Compliance-Team: Reminder: escalate any identity discrepancies to compliance@redwood.com and retain copies in the secure onboarding folder.
Leah (People Ops): Summary of action items: (1) Noah confirm parking passes + escort (2) Priya confirm laptops staged + sticky Wi-Fi (3) Maya upload docs + cc compliance (4) Leah will add Maya to benefits Zoom at 11. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
